response.sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_track_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) as ratio FROM MediaType m LEFT JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "For each media type" includes all rows in the MediaType table, even those with no tracks. Media types without tracks will have NULL ratios (from AVG of empty set). The phrase "any missing ratios last" supports this interpretation—it accounts for media types with NULL ratios appearing after non-NULL ones.

alternatives.interpretation: "For each media type" refers only to distinct MediaTypeId values that actually appear in the Track table. Under this reading, there would be no missing/NULL ratios, making that phrase extraneous or precautionary.
alternatives.sql: SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_track_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) as ratio FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
